newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia's industrial unrest may grow - Reith.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia's industrial unrest may grow - Reith.

text.p: Australia may experience a short-term rise in the number of industrial disputes in reaction to the government's planned labour market reforms, Industrial Relations Minister Peter Reith said.
Reith's comments in a letter to the latest edition of The Economist magazine rebutted suggestions in an earlier Economist article that industrial unrest was set to grow in Australia.

"You suggest that the number of industrial disputes in Australia will rise. In the short term, this may be the case, as many governments that have introduced labour-market reforms...have experienced," Reith wrote.
